title: Technical Support Representative
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.


**The Role:**  

  

The Technical Support Representative role involves resolving technical support issues, primarily focusing on AV hardware and software, from business customers and handling escalations from Tier 1 team members.
  

  

**Your Contribution:**

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech.


In this role you will:  



  

* Troubleshooting video conference system issues via phone, email, and chat.
* Resolving escalated support tickets from the Tier 1 support team.
* Assisting the Tier 1 support team by providing guidance to resolve tickets without escalation.
* Providing ad\-hoc feedback about trends, new issues, and the voice of the customer.
* Assisting with related projects during periods of low technical support volume.
* Suggesting process improvements when opportunities are identified.

  

**Key Qualification:**For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:


* Minimum 3 years of experience in AV technical support capacity, with at least 1\-year video\-conference troubleshooting experience.
* Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong and verifiable knowledge of customer care processes and techniques.
* Experience with Salesforce/Oracle/Zendesk support ticketing systems.
* Experience with one or more VC software services: Zoom, Skype, Google Hangouts.
* Demonstrate the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new technologies, adapt to new processes and procedures, and handle moderate\-to\-high phone call volumes.

\#LI\-MR2


Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on\-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in\-house.
  

  

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!  



  

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
  

  

If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at \+1\-510\-713\-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Material Data Management System Administrator
description:
**Position Overview**


Ascend Performance Materials is seeking a Material Data Management System Administrator to support the configuration, data expansion, and ongoing improvement of our web\-based material data management system.


This role requires a blend of technical data handling skills and a strong background in understanding material properties, technical datasheets, testing standards, and engineering documentation. You will focus on preparing the system to receive structured material, product, and technical data using tools such as SQL, Python, Excel, and platform\-native upload features.

**Targeted Outcomes**

* Support the successful expansion and ongoing maintenance of Ascend's web\-based material data management system.
* Develop repeatable processes for preparing, formatting, validating, and uploading material and product data into the system.
* Enable efficient mass uploads of technical data from Excel, Word, PDF, and legacy source files.
* Support technical engineers and business users by improving workflows, reporting, and access to accurate material data

**Key Responsibilities**

**System Configuration \& Administration:**

* Configure and maintain the web\-based material data management platform, including user workflows, templates, forms, user roles, and system settings.
* Format and structure system fields to store material, product, and technical data in a consistent and searchable format.
* Configure low\-code/no\-code features including forms, approval routing, data views, and reporting tools.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, coordinate with engineering or software vendors, and track issues through resolution

**Data Formatting, Migration \& Mass Uploads:**

* Utilize SQL, Python, Excel, and platform\-native tools for data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading.
* Extract unstructured or semi\-structured data from Word, PDF, and Excel documents into database\-ready formats.
* Perform mass uploads of product data, technical datasheets, property tables, document links, and related literature.
* Audit legacy systems to resolve missing, duplicated, inconsistent, or improperly formatted entries.

**Material Data \& Cross\-Functional Support:**

* Work closely with technical engineering and product teams to translate data requirements into structured fields and reports.
* Maintain revision control, data traceability, and controlled\-document practices across product data.
* Build reporting dashboards and analytics using Excel, Power BI, SQL, or native platform reporting tools.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Management, Materials Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Data Management:** Proven experience working with structured data formatting, data transformation, migration, and mass upload processes.
* **Document Extraction:** Demonstrated experience extracting and preparing data from Excel, Word, PDF, and technical documents.
* **Technical Skills:** Working knowledge of **SQL**, **Python**, Excel, Power BI, and database concepts.
* **System Support:** Experience supporting web\-based enterprise applications, technical data systems, or document management platforms, including low\-code/no\-code configurations.
* **Vendor \& User Support:** Background working with software vendors or technical support teams to resolve application bugs and system issues.
* **Domain Exposure (Preferred):** Familiarity with material properties, product datasheets, testing standards, or engineering documentation is a strong plus

Ascend Performance Materials is the premium provider of high\-quality chemicals, fibers and plastics focused on improving quality of life and inspiring a better tomorrow through innovation. Our global workforce makes the materials used to make safer vehicles, cleaner energy, better medical devices, smarter appliances, and longer\-lasting apparel and consumer goods. We are committed to safety, sustainability, and the success of our customers and our communities.

Together, OARS gives us a shared language and clear direction. These values guide our decisions, shape priorities and set expectations as we move forward – aligned, focused and committed to creating performance materials that improve lives today and inspire a better tomorrow.
